video.title: Finally !!! 🥳 Building a PC 🖥from my own Salary 🤑 - Mini Vlog #cloud #gamingpc #pcbuild #devops

transcript.text: So, I always dreamt of buying myself a
strong PC to do everyday tasks as a
DevOps engineer, play some games, but
faster.
After saving my salary for months
working as a DevOps engineer, I saved
some money. So, this was the time to
fulfill my dream and build a PC. After
doing a lot of research, me and my
friend decided to go with these
components. So, first we have ASUS ROG
Strix Z690 Gaming Wi-Fi motherboard,
Intel Core i9 12th generation processor,
G.Skill RGB DDR5 RAM, 32 GB, 1 TB
Samsung SSD storage,
1 TB of HDD storage,
ASUS ROG Strix GeForce RTX 3060 graphics
card, 850 W of power supply by MSI, and
a sexy cabinet by NZXT with numerous fan
to hold all these equipments.
Amazing.
Subscribe to my channel and watch the
next video where I'm going to test out
this system. Comment down which game
should I play first on this. Thank you.
